Name: Jozabad, Captain of Manasseh
Summary: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:20: Captain of the thousands of Manasseh who fell to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jozabad in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
